How to Apply
Applications to one of our graduate programs (MA/MSc/PhD) are handled by the Faculty of Graduate Studies application site where a list of required application materials is available. Additional advice about the application process and recommended preparation for the mathematics and statistics graduate programs can be found in our FAQ section.
When you apply for the MA, MSc, and PhD programs, please include this fillable supplementary information form and indicate the specialization (stream) to which you wish to apply. The supplementary information form should indicate which faculty members you are interested in working with and/or an area of specialization (pure math/applied math/statistics).
To apply fill out the Graduate Application Form
As a prospective student, you are responsible for seeking out a potential supervisor to help guide your graduate career. List of potential Supervisors
All applicants must complete the Degree and Program Form and submit it along with other requirements of the application. Applications without this form will not be considered.

Financial Engineering Diploma
The Financial Engineering (FE) Diploma is available as an area of concentration within Master's and Doctoral degrees (degree concurrent option) and as a stand-alone graduate diploma (direct entry option). The stand-alone FE Diploma is handled through the Schulich School of Business. Applications for this diploma, when done concurrently with one of our graduate degrees, are handled internally by the Department of Mathematics and Statistics.
To apply contact the individual diploma coordinator directly.
